say:1:1123615001:1.text: Ragnar, one of our tamers, is stressing out over a missing lizard.
say:1:1123615001:1.source_cn: 氏族驯养的蜥蜴失踪了一只。我们的驯兽师，拉格纳，正在为...

say:2:1123615002:1.text: He's been searching for it near the <style="highlight">Spider Wasteland</style> for quite some time but always comes back empty-handed.
say:2:1123615002:1.source_cn: 他已经在<style=highlight>赤沙蛛域附近...

say:3:1123615003:1.text: If you've got some time to spare, please help him out.
say:3:1123615003:1.source_cn: 如果方便，就请你过去帮帮他吧。
say:3:1123615003:1.male: If you've got some time to spare, please help him out.
say:3:1123615003:1.female: If you've got some time to spare, please help him out.

say:0:1123616001:0.text: Kruger sent you to help me? Wonderful!
say:0:1123616001:0.source_cn: 克鲁格让你来帮我？太好了，我正需要帮手。
say:0:1123616001:0.male: Kruger sent you to help me? Wonderful!
say:0:1123616001:0.female: Kruger sent you to help me? Wonderful!

say:1:1123616002:0.text: I've looked everywhere, but there's no trace of that lizard!
say:1:1123616002:0.source_cn: 这附近都快被我找遍了，也没见着那蜥蜴的踪影！你快帮我一...
say:1:1123616002:0.male: I've looked everywhere, but there's no trace of that lizard!
say:1:1123616002:0.female: I've looked everywhere, but there's no trace of that lizard!

say:0:1123617001:0.text: I think that lizard might've wandered into the <style="highlight">Spider Wasteland</style>.
say:0:1123617001:0.source_cn: 看起来，那只蜥蜴像是跑进<style=highligh...
say:0:1123617001:0.male: I think that lizard might've wandered into the <style="highlight">Spider Wasteland</style>.
say:0:1123617001:0.female: I think that lizard might've wandered into the <style="highlight">Spider Wasteland</style>.

say:1:1123617002:0.text: Spider Wasteland?! I can't go in there!
say:1:1123617002:0.source_cn: 赤沙蛛域？！我可不敢进去找它！

say:2:1123617003:0.text: Can you help me catch a <style="highlight">sandbeast</style>? We can <style="highlight">grill its meat</style> and lure the lizard out!
say:2:1123617003:0.source_cn: 要不这样吧，你帮我杀只<style=highlight...
say:2:1123617003:0.male: Can you help me catch a <style="highlight">sandbeast</style>? We can <style="highlight">grill its meat</style> and lure the lizard out!
say:2:1123617003:0.female: Can you help me catch a <style="highlight">sandbeast</style>? We can <style="highlight">grill its meat</style> and lure the lizard out!

say:0:1123618001:0.text: We've got everything. Let's go see the tamer.
say:0:1123618001:0.source_cn: 拿到肉排的原料了，回去交给驯兽师吧。
say:0:1123618001:0.male: We've got everything. Let's go see the tamer.
say:0:1123618001:0.female: We've got everything. Let's go see the tamer.

say:0:1123619001:0.text: Do it like this and then like this... Ha! The grilled meat is done!
say:0:1123619001:0.source_cn: 这样，再这样……蜥蜴最爱的烤肉排就做出来了！

say:1:1123619002:0.text: I'm scared of the Spider Wasteland. Please lure the lizard out for me!
say:1:1123619002:0.source_cn: 我还是不太敢靠近赤沙蛛域，你帮我用烤肉排把它引出来吧！
say:1:1123619002:0.male: I'm scared of the Spider Wasteland. Please lure the lizard out for me!
say:1:1123619002:0.female: I'm scared of the Spider Wasteland. Please lure the lizard out for me!

say:1:1123621001:1.text: Thanks a lot. Without your help, I might never have found this little rascal.
say:1:1123621001:1.source_cn: 多谢了。要不是你，我恐怕再也找不回这家伙了。
say:1:1123621001:1.male: Thanks a lot. Without your help, I might never have found this little rascal.
say:1:1123621001:1.female: Thanks a lot. Without your help, I might never have found this little rascal.

say:2:1123621002:1.text: I never thought he would really end up in the Spider Wasteland... I'm totally scared of spiders and their hairy legs!
say:2:1123621002:1.source_cn: 没想到它真的跑到赤沙蛛域去了……我最怕的就是那些长着毛...

say:3:1123621003:1.text: ... What?! Why are there so many spiders here all of a sudden?
say:3:1123621003:1.source_cn: ……等、等等！怎么突然出现了这么多蜘蛛？！

say:0:1123622001:0.text: Those spiders looked even scarier up close! Thanks for coming with me!
say:0:1123622001:0.source_cn: 那些蜘蛛近看更吓人了！还好有你来帮我。
say:0:1123622001:0.male: Those spiders looked even scarier up close! Thanks for coming with me!
say:0:1123622001:0.female: Those spiders looked even scarier up close! Thanks for coming with me!

say:1:1123622002:0.text: Let's bring the lizard back to the clan. You can see Kruger and update him.
say:1:1123622002:0.source_cn: 不说废话了，我这就带着蜥蜴回黑嚎，你也去和克鲁格汇报一声吧。
say:1:1123622002:0.male: Let's bring the lizard back to the clan. You can see Kruger and update him.
say:1:1123622002:0.female: Let's bring the lizard back to the clan. You can see Kruger and update him.

say:1:1123623001:1.source_cn: 已经找到蜥蜴了？那就好。

say:2:1123623002:1.text: Thanks for your help. Otherwise, we might have had to send warriors to the Spider Wasteland just to get the lizard back.
say:2:1123623002:1.source_cn: 多谢你的帮忙。否则我们恐怕得派出一队战士，才能从赤沙蛛...
say:2:1123623002:1.male: Thanks for your help. Otherwise, we might have had to send warriors to the Spider Wasteland just to get the lizard back.
say:2:1123623002:1.female: Thanks for your help. Otherwise, we might have had to send warriors to the Spider Wasteland just to get the lizard back.

say:3:1123623003:1.text: If possible, please help us out again if something similar takes place in the future.
say:3:1123623003:1.source_cn: 如果再发生类似的事，也请你尽可能地帮帮忙吧。
say:3:1123623003:1.male: If possible, please help us out again if something similar takes place in the future.
say:3:1123623003:1.female: If possible, please help us out again if something similar takes place in the future.
